title: Coherent adic conditions under closed pushforward
statement:
theorem closedImmersion_formal_pushforward_conditions {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    (G : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Z.Modules) (hG : IsCoherentFormalModule (I.comap i) G) :
    IsCoherentFormalModule I (G ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward i)

source.place: Tags 087T, 088A (identification of supported formal systems), equation 0880

proof.text: Coherence implies quasi-coherence; finite closed pushforward preserves coherence on every term.

The image comparison for the positive power n+1 identifies the image of the pushed-forward upstairs product inclusion with the downstairs product inclusion. The upstairs inclusion is zero by its zero source, hence the pushed-forward image and then the downstairs product are zero.
Compose the canonical quotient comparison with the pushforward of the upstairs adic isomorphism. Its projection equation followed by functoriality proves the transition equation.
